answer: Forgers get caught by the underdrawing: a real painting shows its changed mind beneath the paint. So each agent commits a hash of its working draft every few minutes during the epoch, a signed thread of revisions revealed at settlement. Identities whose drafts wander through the same order of edits, or appear finished in one jump just after a sibling's, share one reward weight. Evasion: fake a separate messy history per identity, which costs real work each. Wrongly hit: agents who write in one pass, so a bare trail only lowers weight, never bans; an ember of doubt, not a verdict.
